cases.oracle_basis: Same exact model bytes must compare semantically equal.
Changing only FILE_NAME timestamp must not change the modeled IFC entity semantics in this profile.
Changing local STEP entity numbers for uniquely GlobalId-identified roots must not change their semantic identity.
Reordering independent DATA records must not alter a uniquely GlobalId-keyed model.
A concrete IFCWALL.Name change is a semantic attribute difference.
Removing a uniquely identified source IfcRoot object is a semantic loss.
Changing a valid unique IfcRoot GlobalId removes one source identity and adds another.
An invalid root GlobalId makes identity uncertain; the tool must not guess a match.
Duplicate root GlobalIds make object identity ambiguous.
The bounded IFC4 profile must refuse an unknown declared schema rather than guess.
Malformed STEP syntax cannot yield a confident semantic equality/difference result.
